name: stack-e2e
description: M13 (D8) golden-path black-box test: assign -> conversion -> results against the whole real stack running together (both apps/api and apps/event-processor actually up). Deliberately depends on neither app — only jest/ts-jest and the platform fetch() — so it stays an honest black-box test and never needs a fragile cross-package dev dependency (see .agents/guides/backend/docker.md).
